recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, extreme close-up portrait of a face featuring heavy solarization and false-color mapping. The image is characterized by high-contrast shadows and a vibrant, grainy texture where skin tones are replaced by saturated magentas, oranges, and greens. Typography is arranged in a vertical stack on the left and a horizontal baseline at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme close-up crop focusing on the eyes and nose
High-contrast black shadows against neon-saturated highlights
Vertical text alignment mirroring the left edge of the frame
Grainy, pointillist texture across all color transitions
coreInvariants: Deep black shadows with no detail
Tight facial framing cutting off the top of the head

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered extreme close-up; the face fills 90% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The eyes, positioned in the upper third of the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves down the nose to the mustache, then tracks the vertical text on the left margin.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the deep black shadows on the left side of the face.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme saturation with high value contrast; no soft gradients.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to triadic neon hues and black

letterConstructionRules: Vertical orientation for the primary title
Drop shadow or glow effect for legibility against busy backgrounds
characterSpecificRedesigns: Vertical stacking of individual letters rather than rotated text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in different colors and orientations to create hierarchy.

preserve: Vertical stacking of the main title
avoid: Horizontal rotation for the vertical text

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with sharp terminals.
Excellent contrast and traditional feel that matches the era.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, extreme close-up portrait of a man's face. Apply a heavy solarization effect using a palette of neon magenta, bright orange, and cyan-green. Ensure deep black shadows in the eyes and one side of the face. Add a coarse, grainy stipple texture across the entire image.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add vertical text on the far left margin using a bold serif font, stacked one letter per line. Add a horizontal line of text in the bottom left corner using the same font in a contrasting light blue color. Apply a subtle outer glow to all text for legibility.

verificationChecks: Is the face cropped tightly to the eyes and nose?
Are the colors neon and solarized rather than natural?
Is the left-side text stacked vertically letter-by-letter?
Is there a visible grain or stipple effect?

mustRedesign: Natural skin tones must be replaced with false colors
Standard horizontal text alignment for the main title must be changed to vertical stacking

mustAchieve: Clear typographic hierarchy despite busy background

postGenerationChecks: Check that the vertical text is readable and not rotated.
Ensure the black shadows are deep and lack internal detail.
Verify the grain texture is consistent across the color fields.
Confirm the eyes remain the focal point of the composition.
recipe.reuseFormula: Apply solarization (Magenta/Orange/Green) + Extreme Portrait Crop + Vertical Serif Stacking = Psychedelic Portrait Aesthetic
